source: Instituto Mexicano del Transporte, GeoSSI WFS
processing: Official line coordinates grouped by reporting road labels using explicit aliases. Coordinate precision rounded to 6 decimal places. No segments created between accident points; no invented connectors. Both carriageways/ramps may be present, so do not use sum of line lengths as highway length.

knownSourceIssues: México - Pachuca / México - Tizayuca lines erroneously have Jala concession name; use road nombre instead.
Jala selection excludes east-central México geometry erroneously assigned to that concession.
Road geometry update dates vary and mostly precede 2025.
Point-to-road checks are QA, not evidence that a reported accident occurred on a different road.
